name: OpenTTD 15.3

files.content:
[misc]
fullscreen = false
resolution = 800,600
video_hw_accel = false

[network]
participate_survey = no

notes: Draws with GDI (video_hw_accel off), so it needs no 3D at all. A config file next to the exe keeps it windowed at 800x600 and skips the first-start survey question. OpenTTD loads its default fonts from baseset/OpenTTD-*.ttf with AddFontResourceEx and asks GetFontResourceInfoW for the face name; Wine 11.21 only stubs that function, so OpenTTD falls back to the file name (OpenTTD-Sans), which matches no family and Wine draws its default sans-serif instead. The FontSubstitutes map each file name to the real family. The real fix is implementing GetFontResourceInfoW in Wine.
